label: misaligned
reason: The independent target asserts continuous trace into interpolation space [X,Y]_(1/2) for an X-valued L2 function whose actual distributional derivative lies in L2(Y), under dense continuous embedding X into Y. The formal statement instead assumes hExists and repeats precisely the same proposition as its conclusion. That proposition only bounds an X-valued vector norm by a multiple of itself; the quantified v never occurs in the bound. No time-dependent function, derivative relation, interpolation space, or trace-continuity assertion appears, and iota is merely any continuous linear map without density or injectivity. Thus the theorem is a tautological norm-bound proxy, not the selected Lions-Magenes trace theorem. This judgment concerns statement alignment, not logical falsity.
